name: Twilio Docs
description: Twilio Docs lets agents search the Twilio documentation and read full parameter schemas for Twilio API operations, such as Messaging, Voice, and Verify. It needs no account and no key.

prompts.text: What parameters does the Twilio API need to send an SMS with a status callback?
How do I start and check a phone verification with Twilio Verify?
What do I need to register for A2P 10DLC messaging in the US?

apps.name: Twilio Docs
apps.description: Twilio documentation and API schema lookup, over the Twilio MCP server with no sign-in.
